evals.prompt: Acabo de descomponer un plan aprobado en sesiones y bloques con task-planning; el run vive en un worktree dedicado y el plan está en ~/.claude/plans/mi-feature.md. Abre la bitácora del run.
evals.expected_output: Copies the bundled template to .claude/binnacle.md in the worktree root, fills the frontmatter (task, branch, worktree, base_branch, base_sha, plan_path, status: in-progress, current_session, last_updated), writes the session plan ending with Sesión R and the block breakdown, sets read_until_line to the last line of the file, and ensures .claude/binnacle.md is in the repo's local exclude file without touching the tracked .gitignore.
expectations: The agent copies references/binnacle-template.md to .claude/binnacle.md at the worktree root
The agent fills the frontmatter including plan_path with the approved plan's path and base_sha as the frozen merge-base SHA and base_branch as human context only
The agent writes the Plan de sesiones ending with a Sesión R — code review executed manually by the user
The agent sets read_until_line to the last line of the file since no entries exist yet
The agent appends .claude/binnacle.md to the git common dir's info/exclude only if absent, never editing the tracked .gitignore

evals.prompt: Sesión nueva tras un /clear, dentro de un worktree que ya tiene .claude/binnacle.md de un run en progreso. Retoma el run.
evals.expected_output: Checks the status gate first, reads the binnacle with limit: read_until_line instead of whole, reconciles against git log base_sha..HEAD trusting commits over the file, reads the plan at plan_path in full before registering tasks, re-registers only the current session's tasks with TaskCreate from the Bloques section with block codes as first title token and 'invoke log-binnacle' as final task, and continues from the Siguiente section of the most recent entry.
expectations: The agent reads the frontmatter first and branches on status before anything else
The agent reads the binnacle bounded by read_until_line rather than loading the full history
The agent reconciles against git log base_sha..HEAD, trusting commits when they disagree with the binnacle
The agent reads the plan at plan_path in full before registering the session's tasks
The agent re-registers only the current session's tasks, with block codes as first title token
The agent registers 'invoke log-binnacle' as the session's final task
The agent continues from the Siguiente section of the latest entry, not from its own guess
The agent does not edit or summarize any existing entry

evals.prompt: Sesión nueva tras un /clear en un worktree con bitácora en progreso. Al intentar leer el plan, el archivo apuntado por plan_path ya no existe en ~/.claude/plans/ — parece que se limpió el directorio. Retoma el run.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops before registering any task, reports the missing plan path and asks the user for its current location — it does not glob ~/.claude/plans/ for a lookalike, does not proceed planless, and does not rewrite plan_path on its own. Once the user confirms the new path, it verifies with ls, updates plan_path and last_updated, and notes the repair for the next entry's Desviaciones.
expectations: The agent stops before registering tasks when the Read of plan_path fails
The agent asks the user for the plan's current location instead of picking a lookalike file
The agent does not proceed without the plan
After user confirmation, the agent verifies the new path with ls and updates plan_path and last_updated
The agent plans to note the repair in the next session entry's Desviaciones

evals.prompt: Sesión nueva tras un /clear en un worktree con bitácora en progreso cuyo frontmatter dice plan_path: none. Retoma el run.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the full resume procedure and skips only the plan-read step because plan_path is none — it does not ask for a plan, does not materialize one, and continues with task re-registration from Bloques.
expectations: The agent skips the plan read because plan_path is none
The agent does not ask the user for a plan or create one during resume
The agent still re-registers the current session's tasks and continues normally
